# Upstream JavaScript fixture

Unmodified published ESM files from **dset 3.1.4**, by Luke Edwards, MIT licensed.
The upstream license is included. These are not rewritten demonstration helpers.

- Repository: https://github.com/lukeed/dset
- Release: https://registry.npmjs.org/dset/3.1.4
- Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/dset/-/dset-3.1.4.tgz
- Published tarball integrity: `sha512-2QF/g9/zTaPDc3BjNcVTGoBbXBgYfMTTceLaYcFJ/W9kggFUkhxD/hMEeuLKbugyef9SqAx8cpgwlIP/jinUTA==`
- ESM entries: `dset` → `dist/index.mjs`, `dset/merge` → `merge/index.mjs`.

Tests verify the source hashes before compiling and need no network access.
Both files were compared byte-for-byte with the official npm tarball after
verifying its SHA-512 integrity above; whitespace has not been normalized.
The snapshot exists only to make the integration experiment reproducible; it
is not a new production dependency or a fork of dset.
